target_context.window_title: How we halved onboarding drop-off in a banking app
target_context.surrounding_text:
How we halved onboarding drop-off in a banking app
By Nora Lindqvist · 6 min read
When we started, 41% of new customers abandoned signup before verifying their identity. We interviewed 30 of them. The most common reason was not the ID check itself but not knowing how long it would take. We added a progress indicator, an estimated time, and a way to finish later. Drop-off fell to 19% within two months.
The second change was language. We replaced "KYC verification" with "Confirm it's you" and moved the legal text behind a link. Older customers in particular told us the new wording felt less like an interrogation.

Great write-up. Did you test the "finish later" option with users who switch devices?

Yes — about 12% finished on a different device. We send a magic link.

target_context.window_title: How we halved onboarding drop-off in a banking app
target_context.surrounding_text:
How we halved onboarding drop-off in a banking app
By Nora Lindqvist · 6 min read
When we started, 41% of new customers abandoned signup before verifying their identity. We interviewed 30 of them. The most common reason was not the ID check itself but not knowing how long it would take. We added a progress indicator, an estimated time, and a way to finish later. Drop-off fell to 19% within two months.
The second change was language. We replaced "KYC verification" with "Confirm it's you" and moved the legal text behind a link. Older customers in particular told us the new wording felt less like an interrogation.
Comments (3)
Samir Haddad · 2 days ago
Great write-up. Did you test the "finish later" option with users who switch devices?
Nora Lindqvist · 2 days ago
Yes — about 12% finished on a different device. We send a magic link.
Elena Rossi · 1 day ago
We are hiring for exactly this kind of work, happy to connect with anyone who has done something similar.

I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

Dear Ms Hofer,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

Dear Ms Hofer,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandne

Dear Ms Hofer,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

target_context.window_title: How we halved onboarding drop-off in a banking app
target_context.surrounding_text:
How we halved onboarding drop-off in a banking app
By Nora Lindqvist · 6 min read
When we started, 41% of new customers abandoned signup before verifying their identity. We interviewed 30 of them. The most common reason was not the ID check itself but not knowing how long it would take. We added a progress indicator, an estimated time, and a way to finish later. Drop-off fell to 19% within two months.
The second change was language. We replaced "KYC verification" with "Confirm it's you" and moved the legal text behind a link. Older customers in particular told us the new wording felt less like an interrogation.
Comments (3)
Samir Haddad · 2 days ago
Great write-up. Did you test the "finish later" option with users who switch devices?
Nora Lindqvist · 2 days ago
Yes — about 12% finished on a different device. We send a magic link.

We are hiring for exactly this kind of work, happy to connect with anyone who has done something similar.

target_context.window_title: How we halved onboarding drop-off in a banking app
target_context.surrounding_text:
How we halved onboarding drop-off in a banking app
By Nora Lindqvist · 6 min read
When we started, 41% of new customers abandoned signup before verifying their identity. We interviewed 30 of them. The most common reason was not the ID check itself but not knowing how long it would take. We added a progress indicator, an estimated time, and a way to finish later. Drop-off fell to 19% within two months.
The second change was language. We replaced "KYC verification" with "Confirm it's you" and moved the legal text behind a link. Older customers in particular told us the new wording felt less like an interrogation.
Comments (3)
Samir Haddad · 2 days ago
Great write-up. Did you test the "finish later" option with users who switch devices?
Nora Lindqvist · 2 days ago
Yes — about 12% finished on a different device. We send a magic link.
Elena Rossi · 1 day ago
We are hiring for exactly this kind of work, happy to connect with anyone who has done something similar.
Add a comment

I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandne

Dear Ms Hofer,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

Dear Ms Hofer,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandne

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

I am happy to relocate for the role.

Theo Brandner

Dear Ms Hofer,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

Hi, I'm Lena Vogt, a ceramicist working out of a small studio in Innsbruck.
I post new glazes and kiln experiments as @mira_h and teach weekend wheel classes.

Born in 1994 and raised on a farm in the Tyrolean Alps, I started throwing pots at sixteen.
These days I split my time between restaurant commissions and a small online shop.

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.

Dear Ms Hofer,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

target_context.window_title: How we halved onboarding drop-off in a banking app
target_context.surrounding_text:
How we halved onboarding drop-off in a banking app
By Nora Lindqvist · 6 min read
When we started, 41% of new customers abandoned signup before verifying their identity. We interviewed 30 of them. The most common reason was not the ID check itself but not knowing how long it would take. We added a progress indicator, an estimated time, and a way to finish later. Drop-off fell to 19% within two months.
The second change was language. We replaced "KYC verification" with "Confirm it's you" and moved the legal text behind a link. Older customers in particular told us the new wording felt less like an interrogation.
Comments (3)
Samir Haddad · 2 days ago
Great write-up. Did you test the "finish later" option with users who switch devices?
Nora Lindqvist · 2 days ago
Yes — about 12% finished on a different device. We send a magic link.
Elena Rossi · 1 day ago
We are hiring for exactly this kind of work, happy to connect with anyone who has done something similar.

Dear Ms Hofer,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandne

Dear Ms Hofer,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

Dear Ms Hofer,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandne

target_context.window_title: How we halved onboarding drop-off in a banking app
target_context.surrounding_text:
How we halved onboarding drop-off in a banking app
By Nora Lindqvist · 6 min read
When we started, 41% of new customers abandoned signup before verifying their identity. We interviewed 30 of them. The most common reason was not the ID check itself but not knowing how long it would take. We added a progress indicator, an estimated time, and a way to finish later. Drop-off fell to 19% within two months.
The second change was language. We replaced "KYC verification" with "Confirm it's you" and moved the legal text behind a link. Older customers in particular told us the new wording felt less like an interrogation.

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

Dear Ms Hofer,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

Dear Ms Hofer,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,

Dear Ms Hofer,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

criteria.e000:
Dear Ms Hofer,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandne

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

Dear Ms Hofer,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

target_context.window_title: How we halved onboarding drop-off in a banking app
target_context.surrounding_text:
How we halved onboarding drop-off in a banking app
By Nora Lindqvist · 6 min read
When we started, 41% of new customers abandoned signup before verifying their identity. We interviewed 30 of them. The most common reason was not the ID check itself but not knowing how long it would take. We added a progress indicator, an estimated time, and a way to finish later. Drop-off fell to 19% within two months.
The second change was language. We replaced "KYC verification" with "Confirm it's you" and moved the legal text behind a link. Older customers in particular told us the new wording felt less like an interrogation.
Comments (3)
Samir Haddad · 2 days ago
Great write-up. Did you test the "finish later" option with users who switch devices?
Nora Lindqvist · 2 days ago
Yes — about 12% finished on a different device. We send a magic link.
Elena Rossi · 1 day ago
We are hiring for exactly this kind of work, happy to connect with anyone who has done something similar.

Born in 1994 and raised on a farm in the Tyrolean Alps, I started throwing pots at sixteen.
These days I split my time between restaurant commissions and a small online shop.

state.source_document:
Dear Ms Hofer,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

state.source_document:
Dear Ms Hofer,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

Dear Ms Hofer,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

Dear Ms Hofer,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

expected:
Dear Ms Hofer,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

target_context.window_title: How we halved onboarding drop-off in a banking app
target_context.surrounding_text:
How we halved onboarding drop-off in a banking app
By Nora Lindqvist · 6 min read
When we started, 41% of new customers abandoned signup before verifying their identity. We interviewed 30 of them. The most common reason was not the ID check itself but not knowing how long it would take. We added a progress indicator, an estimated time, and a way to finish later. Drop-off fell to 19% within two months.
The second change was language. We replaced "KYC verification" with "Confirm it's you" and moved the legal text behind a link. Older customers in particular told us the new wording felt less like an interrogation.
Comments (3)
Samir Haddad · 2 days ago
Great write-up. Did you test the "finish later" option with users who switch devices?
Nora Lindqvist · 2 days ago
Yes — about 12% finished on a different device. We send a magic link.
Elena Rossi · 1 day ago
We are hiring for exactly this kind of work, happy to connect with anyone who has done something similar.

Great, one sec, copying it from my résumé.
ChatGPT can make mistakes. Check important info.

Dear Ms Hofer,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Landscape Architect position at Grünraum Studio.
I graduated in landscape planning this summer and spent two internships designing school gardens.

What draws me to Grünraum is your work on climate-resilient streets and shaded courtyards.
I want to learn how planting plans survive real budgets, and your mixed teams are the place to do it.

I can start on 1 December 2026 and am available for interviews on any weekday afternoon.
I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

I am happy to relocate for the role.

Kind regards,
Theo Brandner

Born in 1994 and raised on a farm in the Tyrolean Alps, I started throwing pots at sixteen.
These days I split my time between restaurant commissions and a small online shop.
